sentences.text: Moscovium is a superheavy synthetic element with symbol Mc and atomic number 115 .	superheavy	Transactinide element	synthetic element	synthetic element	symbol	chemical symbol	atomic number	atomic number

It was first synthesized in 2003 by a joint team of Russian and American scientists at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research -LRB- JINR -RRB- in Dubna , Russia .	Joint Institute for Nuclear Research	Joint Institute for Nuclear Research	Dubna	Dubna

In December 2015 , it was recognized as one of four new elements by the Joint Working Party of international scientific bodies IUPAC and IUPAP .	Joint Working Party	IUPAC/IUPAP Joint Working Party	IUPAC	International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry	IUPAP	International Union of Pure and Applied Physics
On 28 November 2016 , it was officially named after the Moscow region , which the JINR is situated in .	Moscow	Moscow
Moscovium is an extremely radioactive element : its most stable known isotope , moscovium-290 , has a half-life of only 0.8 seconds .	radioactive	radioactive	half-life	half-life
In the periodic table , it is a p-block transactinide element .	periodic table	periodic table	p-block	p-block	transactinide element	transactinide element

It is a member of the 7th period and is placed in group 15 as the heaviest pnictogen , although it has not been confirmed to behave as a heavier homologue of the pnictogen bismuth .	7th period	period 7 element	pnictogen	pnictogen	homologue	homology (chemistry)	bismuth	bismuth

Moscovium is calculated to have some properties similar to its lighter homologues , nitrogen , phosphorus , arsenic , antimony , and bismuth , and to be a post-transition metal , although it should also show several major differences from them .	nitrogen	nitrogen	phosphorus	phosphorus	arsenic	arsenic	antimony	antimony	bismuth	bismuth	post-transition metal	post-transition metal
About 100 atoms of moscovium have been observed to date , all of which have been shown to have mass numbers from 287 to 290 .
